test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

He will return in a hour.
solution:
The correct answer is **'in a'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is in the article used before **"hour."**
 
• The correct article to use
